title: Vision to Reality: Stop Working, Start Living
author: Honoree Corder
target_audience: Readers interested in setting and achieving goals
Anyone aspiring to turn their dreams into actionable results
primary_purpose: To guide readers through a structured process to clarify their vision, set tangible goals, and create a step-by-step plan to achieve those goals, ultimately enabling greater freedom and fulfillment in life and business.

structure_format.organization: Divided into clear sections that outline steps for vision creation, planning, execution, and sustaining results
features: Action plans and exercises at the end of chapters

key_concepts_lessons: A clear vision is the foundation for meaningful success.
Setting specific, measurable goals bridges the gap between desire and accomplishment.
Taking consistent, focused action is key to progress.
Life design requires proactive choices rather than reactive habits.
Work can be a vehicle for realizing a fulfilling lifestyle rather than the end in itself.
Accountability and regular review are essential for lasting change.
notable_features: Focus on both mindset and tactics
Includes motivational quotes and real-life success stories from coaching clients
Designed for implementation, not just reading
cultural_historical_context: Published during a period of increasing focus on entrepreneurship, personal growth, and work-life balance, the book addresses common frustrations about overwork and under-fulfillment in the modern business world.
reception_impact: Adopted as a resource by coaches and entrepreneurs
Praised for clarity, actionability, and motivational content
Some readers view the steps as universal frameworks, while others seek more detailed case studies
Helped readers shift mindsets toward intentional living rather than perpetual busyness
comparable_titles: The Miracle Morning by Hal Elrod
Start with Why by Simon Sinek
The One Thing by Gary Keller and Jay Papasan
Designing Your Life by Bill Burnett and Dave Evans
